module: Texture management for the editor's dynamic decals system. Scans /art/dynamicDecals/textures (*.jpg and *.png), reads/writes for each a "sidecar" file <texture>.dynDecalTexture.json (version, type, isSdfCompatible, tags, vehicle), maintains the tag indexes and migrates old sidecars via editor_api_dynamicDecals_sidecarFileMigration. A missing sidecar is created from a default template.
notes: reloadTextureFiles contains an "if true then return end" before the sort: textureFiles is therefore never sorted nor are the tags sorted by usage (dead code behind it).
getAndFlushMissingSidecarFiles sets missingSidecarFiles to nil after reading; if called before any scan, shallowcopy(nil) may fail (inferred from code).
addTexture (via onFileChanged) creates the default sidecar but does not add it to the tag indexes (direct jsonWriteFile).

setup.desc: Fetches the migration extension, scans the textures (blocking) and creates the textures folder if missing.

setupAsync.desc: Version of setup() to run in a job (jobsystem): the scan is spread over several frames. The callbacks are passed to reloadTextureFilesAsync.

reloadTextureFiles.desc: Rediscovers all textures, rebuilds the tags, migrates sidecars of version < 2 and creates the missing sidecars (listed in missingSidecarFiles).

reloadTextureFilesAsync.desc: Yielding equivalent of reloadTextureFiles, for a job: the discovery and each processed texture call callbacks.yield.

callbacks.desc: yield(section) during discovery and after each file; onTotal(total) number of textures found; onProgress(count) textures processed since the last call

getTextureFiles.desc: List of known texture paths (nil before the first scan).

getSidecarTemplate.desc: Default sidecar template (version 2, type color, isSdfCompatible=false, empty tags, empty vehicle).

getAndFlushMissingSidecarFiles.desc: Returns a copy of the list of textures whose sidecar was missing at the last scan, then clears the internal list.

sidecarFileExists.desc: Tests whether a texture's sidecar exists.

readSidecarFile.desc: Reads a texture's JSON sidecar, nil if it does not exist.

updateSidecarFile.desc: Writes the sidecar and updates the tag indexes (removes the texture's old tags, adds the new ones).

getTagsWithRefs.desc: Table tag -> list of textures carrying this tag.

onFileChanged.desc: File watching hook. For a png/jpg under the textures folder: 'added'/'modified' adds the texture (creates its sidecar if absent) and emits dynamicDecals_onTextureFileAdded(filepath); 'deleted' removes its tags and the texture, and emits dynamicDecals_onTextureFileDeleted(filepath).
